p: Gen is a recursively self-upgrading agentic harness that runs the coding agent you use — Hanzo Dev, Claude Code, Codex, and custom loops — with full hackability, MCP tools attached, and every session linked to your Hanzo account.
Linux and macOS. hanzo.sh downloads gen’s native build and checks it: its checksum always, its provenance with a signed-in gh. Run it again to upgrade.

code: curl -fsSL https://hanzo.sh | sh -s gen # gen alone curl -fsSL https://hanzo.sh | sh # or every Hanzo tool, gen included
gen # Hanzo Dev, the default gen --claude # Claude Code; any agent is a flag gen --codex " add a test " # a task, run headless

p: Sign in once with the Hanzo CLI, hanzo auth login, and every session is linked to your account.

h2: One runs agents. One is an agent.
The agent you use is a flag.

p: Each launches as itself, with its own interface and its own habits, and Gen around it. gen --help lists every one.
Tools, models, sessions and fences, each set by a flag.

code: gen --claude --cloud # its model calls through api.hanzo.ai gen --claude --cloud --model enso-ultra gen --codex --no-link # keep the session on this machine gen --resume < session-i d> # pick a linked session back up gen --claude -- -c # after --, the agent's own arguments

h2: The same harness, as hanzo dev.

p: The Hanzo CLI links Gen, so hanzo dev takes the same flags and runs the same session. Use whichever is on your path.

code: hanzo dev # gen hanzo dev --claude # gen --claude hanzo dev --codex --cloud # gen --codex --cloud

p: The harness, every agent's launcher and how its output is read are on GitHub, one file an agent.
